andaman.name: Andaman
andaman.title: Andaman & Nicobar — experience the extraordinary.
andaman.lead: Islands floating in splendid isolation in the Bay of Bengal, with some of India's best diving and snorkelling.

blocks.text: Splendid isolation in the Bay of Bengal.

The Andaman and Nicobar Islands sit east of the Indian mainland, and Port Blair — the gateway to these pristine islands — offers water-based activities like snorkelling, scuba diving, and sea cruises alongside a rich history and culture.
Divers get the best conditions between December and April; bird watchers should aim for the winter months.
From history at Cellular Jail to the reefs off Havelock.
A three-storey British-era prison from 1906, now a National Memorial to India's freedom fighters.
Hugged by coconut trees and tropical jungle — complete serenity for its visitors.
A coconut-palm fringed beach 6km from Port Blair, ideal for swimming and water sports.
Tucked deep within mangroves and rainforest — a highly recommended addition to any itinerary.
One of the densest coral reef ecosystems around — soft and hard corals, and a huge variety of fish.
Unmatched flora and fauna, with Port Blair visible from the peak.
Port Blair, Havelock & Neil Island packages.
Full day-by-day itinerary shared on request.
December to April is best for diving; winter months are best for bird watching.
Not Andamanese or Nicobarese — it's Bengali, followed by Hindi, Tamil, Telugu and Malayalam.
The Dugong, a gentle sea cow.
Barren Island, located right here in the Andaman Islands.

bali.name: Bali
bali.title: Bali — an Indonesian paradise that feels like a fantasy.
bali.lead: Temples wrapped in jungle, rice terraces at dawn, and sunsets over Uluwatu's cliffs. Whatever kind of holiday you're picturing, Bali has a version of it.

blocks.text: Temples Beaches Volcano Tours Visa on Arrival
An ideal retreat for beaches, temples & rice terraces.

Adventurous, spiritual, or purely lazy-by-the-pool — Bali flexes to whatever holiday you're after. It's home to the coral reefs of Tulamben, the mountain peaks of Kintamani, the buzz of Seminyak and Kuta, and the quieter, traditional village life of Ubud.
Between the sunrises over Mount Batur and the sunsets at Uluwatu, it's a destination that's hard to leave once you've landed.
The tours our travelers ask for most, built into every LeisureFlies Bali package.
One of the most beautiful islands in the world, reached by boat — home to the iconic Broken Beach.
Visit the exotic Ulun Danu Beratan Temple, set on a high tableland surrounded by ponds.
Explore Bali's architecture, then take to the ocean for snorkeling, banana boat rides, and a 44-metre water slide.
View Mount Batur and the Ubud Tegalalang rice terraces, then visit Celuk's gold & silver craft village and the Holy Spring Temple.
Parasailing, banana boat and jet ski rides, the roaring Water Blow at Nusa Dua, and Uluwatu's cliffside temple with Kecak fire dance.
Shop the Ubud Art Market and visit Celuk & Mas villages, known for centuries-old craft traditions.
Full day tour of watersports & Uluwatu Temple — private
Kintamani tour with Mount Batur, Cantik Coffee Plantation, Tegalalang Rice Terraces, Tukad Cepung Falls — private
Bedugul tour with Beratan Temple, Bali Botanical Garden, photo stop at Handara Gate & Twin Lake View Point — private
Return airport transfers on private basis
Nusa Penida day west tour from North Kuta hotel with lunch — SIC
Ubud tour with Alas Harum, Tegalalang Rice Terraces, Tibumana Falls — private
Full day tour of Lempuyang Temple and Amed Beach — private
Full day tour of Garuda Wisnu Kencana Cultural Park, Melasti Beach, Uluwatu Temple with Kecak Dance — private
Return airport transfers on private basis
Full day tour of watersports & Uluwatu Temple — private
Full day tour with Tanah Lot Temple, Alas Kedaton Monkey Forest, Taman Ayun Temple — private
Kintamani tour with Mount Batur, Cantik Coffee Plantation, Tegalalang Rice Terraces, Tukad Cepung Falls — private
Ubud shopping tour with Ubud Art Market, Celuk & Mas villages — private
Return airport transfers on private basis

Getting a visa for Indonesia is refreshingly simple — Indian travelers don't need to apply in advance. A Visa on Arrival is purchased directly at the immigration hall on landing in Bali (or anywhere in Indonesia), and it's valid for 30 days.
Don't enter temples with your shoes on, and avoid using your left hand when giving or receiving gifts.
The world's most expensive coffee comes from Bali — it's not your typical coffee bean.
Indonesian waters host double the marine species found in the Great Barrier Reef.
Balinese babies aren't allowed to touch the ground for their first few months — they're considered little angels.

dubai.name: Dubai
dubai.title: Dubai — experience the extraordinary.
dubai.lead: One of the most sought-after destinations among the seven cities of the UAE — pure, unfiltered luxury.

blocks.text: Dubai makes you feel what luxury life literally looks like. Roaming the city in a limousine, viewing exotic building structures, is simply splendid.
Having dinner on a luxurious cruise under shining stars takes your breath away — and standing atop the world's tallest building pleases you from the bottom of your heart.
The essentials, plus what to explore beyond them.
A great short break for shopping, sunbathing, sporting events, and fine dining.
Cruise, buffet dinner, live shows and a licensed bar — the trio's most important part.
Evening dune bashing on 4x4 land cruisers, sand boarding, BBQ dinner, tanura show and belly dance.
The world's tallest building — views from the 124th floor, then the Dubai Aquarium below.
The Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, accommodating 40,000 worshippers, plus the world's largest Ferrari theme park.
The world's largest waterslide tube, and an 11-million-litre aquarium for an underwater yoga session.
Every package includes daily breakfast, airport transfers, and the Dubai Trio (city tour, desert safari, dhow cruise) as standard. Full day-by-day itinerary shared on request.
Only soft copies required: a scanned colour copy of your passport's first & last page, a passport-size photo on white background, and your PAN card. The e-visa is issued digitally and can be printed.
Snapping photos — don't photograph government buildings without consent.
Don't consume alcohol or illicit substances outside licensed venues — follow local norms and enjoy the journey.

goa.name: Goa
goa.title: Goa — India's pocket-sized paradise.
goa.lead: A kaleidoscopic blend of Indian and Portuguese cultures, sweetened with sun, sea, sand, seafood and susegad.

blocks.text: One of India's top holiday destinations, and it's easy to see why.

From shopping at local markets to feasting on Goan cuisine and endless water sports, Goa is spoilt for choice. It's a kaleidoscopic blend of Indian and Portuguese cultures, wrapped in sun, sea, sand, seafood, and susegad.
North Goa brings the energy — beaches, nightlife, forts. South Goa slows it down with quieter shores and turtle-nesting beaches. Most travelers do a bit of both.
A mix of North and South Goa highlights, built into every LeisureFlies Goa package.
Mandrem, Keri, Morjim, Sinquerim & Candolim — from quiet sunsets to dolphin spotting and jet skiing.
Made famous by 'Dil Chahta Hai', this 1717 hill-top fort offers sweeping views over the Chapora River.
A UNESCO Heritage Site over 400 years old, home to the mummy of St. Xavier, displayed once a decade.
A shopaholic's Saturday night paradise — local handicrafts to designer garments.
A striking four-tiered waterfall on the Mandovi River, roughly 60km from Panaji.
Benaulim, Galgibaga (Olive Ridley turtle nesting), Agonda and Majorda — quieter, more laid-back shores.
Every duration is fully customizable around your preferred mix of North and South Goa. Full day-by-day itinerary shared on request.
Between October and March — visit Feb-March for Goa's Carnival season.
The Anjuna Flea Market on Wednesdays — started in 1975 by "eight finger Eddie", it's the queen of hippie flea markets.
Skip the heels on the beach, and don't drink on public beaches — it's discouraged locally.
Goa is the smallest state in India by area.
Goa celebrates both 15th August and 19th December, marking its freedom from Portuguese rule.
Goan people can apply for a Portuguese passport alongside their Indian one.

himachal.name: Himachal Pradesh
himachal.title: Himachal — the land of gods.
himachal.lead: Snow-laden peaks, ancient temples, and hill stations that have drawn travelers for generations.

blocks.text: Dev Bhoomi — the land of the gods.

Himachal Pradesh sits in the Western Himalayas, earning its nickname 'Dev Bhoomi' from the sheer number of historical temples scattered across the state. Shimla, Manali, Dharamshala, Dalhousie, Chamba, Khajjiar, Kullu and Kasauli are its best-known hill stations.
It's also home to major Hindu pilgrimage sites — Naina Devi, Bajreshwari Mata, Jwala Ji, Chintpurni, Chamunda Devi, Baijnath, Bhimakali and Jakhoo temples among them.
From Shimla's colonial charm to Manali's adventure sports — the essentials of every LeisureFlies Himachal package.
Christ Church, The Mall Road, Shimla State Museum, Sankat Mochan Temple and Summer Hill.
A UNESCO World Heritage narrow-gauge railway — a 5.5-hour ride through deodar and pine forests.
16km from Shimla — ski slopes, a mini zoo, and views over the Potato Research Station.
At 2050m above sea level, Manali is a favorite for both international and domestic paragliders.
Parachuting, paragliding, horse riding, and zorbing — one of Himachal's most popular adventure hubs.
Open June-October, the gateway to Lahaul & Spiti — sledging, snow scooters, and the Rahala Waterfall nearby.
Multiple durations available depending on how much of Shimla, Manali, and surrounding valleys you want to cover. Full day-by-day itinerary shared on request.
March to June, and September to December.
Water currents in Himachal's rivers are strong — avoid standing near cliffs or riverbanks for photos.
Carry cash — ATMs get scarce in remote areas.
Malana village has a strict rule: no outsider may touch a resident's belongings or the village walls.
Shimla sits atop seven hills, including Jakhu Hill and Summer Hill.
Christ Church (built 1857) is India's second-oldest church, after St. John's in Meerut.

kashmir.name: Kashmir
kashmir.title: Kashmir — a paradise on earth.
kashmir.lead: Nature lovers flock to India's northernmost extremity for Gulmarg, Pahalgam, Sonmarg, and the houseboats of Dal Lake.

blocks.text: India's northernmost extremity, made for nature lovers.
The state of Jammu & Kashmir sits mostly in the Himalayan mountains, frequently visited by adventure enthusiasts for trekking, rafting, and skiing.
Some of India's major pilgrimage centers — including the Amarnath Caves and Vaishnodevi Shrine — are situated here too.
From Srinagar's gardens to Pahalgam's saffron fields.
Over 15km around — Srinagar's jewel, with shikaras skiffing goods, children, and travelers across the water.
A UNESCO World Heritage Site, flourishing with indigenous flowers in Persian-style architecture.
2,730m above sea level, with the world's second-highest gondola ride and second-longest cable car.
The jewel of Liddar Valley, part of Asia's only saffron-growing region — hiking, trekking and fishing.
'Meadow of Gold' — a majestic glacier, dense forests, and snow-capped peaks at 2,800m.
12km from Pahalgam — the base camp for trekking to Kolahoi Glacier and Tarsar Lake.
Every package includes a 1-hour shikara ride and local sightseeing across all cities. Full day-by-day itinerary shared on request.
April to June, and October to March.
Heavy woollens, sweaters and scarves — especially for winter travel.
Taxis are easily available for local sightseeing and excursions out of Srinagar.
Kashmir is India's largest producer of saffron, and the third largest in the world.
The Indira Gandhi Memorial Tulip Garden.
The Pir Panjal (Banihal) tunnel — 11,215m long, and Asia's fourth-longest.

kerala.name: Kerala
kerala.title: Kerala — God's own country.
kerala.lead: Serene beaches, tranquil backwaters, lush hill stations and exotic wildlife — a land that never stops amazing you.

blocks.text: Kerala is a destination of equable climate, a long shoreline with serene beaches, tranquil backwaters, lush hill stations and exotic wildlife.
Waterfalls, sprawling plantations, paddy fields, Ayurvedic health holidays, enchanting art forms, and exotic cuisine — Kerala will make you want to explore it inch by inch.
From Munnar's tea gardens to Alleppey's backwaters.
A 4-hour scenic drive through spice plantations, past Valara and Cheeyappara Falls.
Eravikulam National Park (home to the Nilgiri Tahr), Anamudi Peak, and the Tata Tea Museum.
A boat safari through Periyar Tiger Reserve, followed by an evening spice market walk in Kumily village.
A 120-metre luxury houseboat on Vembanad Lake, with traditional Kuttanadan meals onboard.
A rocky promontory creates a calm bay ideal for sea bathing — plus diving, parasailing and windsurfing.
Every package includes all meals aboard the houseboat and local sightseeing across cities. Full day-by-day itinerary shared on request.
Plastic is banned in Kerala — plan accordingly for shopping.
Only visit Ayurveda centers approved by the Ministry of Tourism.
Kerala is the first Indian state to receive rainfall each year.
The Padmanabhaswamy Temple is the wealthiest Hindu temple in the world.
Traditional Kerala houseboats are built entirely from wooden planks, without any iron nails.

maldives.name: Maldives
maldives.title: Maldives — the sunny side of life.
maldives.lead: White sand beaches, turquoise waters, and a marine world that pulls in solo travelers, honeymooners, and families alike.

blocks.text: An utterly awe-inspiring escape into the Indian Ocean.
The Maldives is an awe-inspiring destination of white sand beaches, turquoise waters, majestic islands, and startling marine life — a tranquil vacation for solo travelers, honeymooners, or families.
November through April is peak season, with the most reliable sunshine — though prices climb accordingly across accommodation and activities.
What to do in the Maldives.
Every resort has its own version of these — we help you pick the one that fits.
Some of the clearest waters in the world, with reef life right off most resort jetties.
Traditional fishing trips at golden hour, or a quiet kayak around the lagoon.
Breakfast served on a raft in your own private plunge pool — a Maldives signature.
Private beach dinners, couples' massages, and spa treatments overlooking the water — honeymoon essentials.
How to pick the perfect resort.
Speedboat, domestic flight or seaplane transfers; Garden, Beach, Pool or Water Villa rooms; Breakfast-only through All-Inclusive meal plans — we match all three to your budget and trip length.
The most budget-friendly category — ideal for a 2-3 day stay.
Right on the beach — good for relaxation.
Best for couples' privacy — a great luxurious option for your first 2-3 days.
The famous overwater stilted villa — best saved for your last 1-2 nights.
Sun Island Resort, Adaaran Club Rannalhi, Medhufushi Island Resort, OBLU Xperience Ailafushi.
Dusit Thani, Coco Bodu Hithi, Furaveri Island Resort, Adaaran Prestige Vadoo, Paradise Island Resort & Spa.
Most resorts now offer dedicated vegetarian, Indian and Jain meal options — worth confirming when we book.

mauritius.name: Mauritius
mauritius.title: Mauritius — it's a pleasure.
mauritius.lead: A volcanic island of lagoons and palm-fringed beaches, ringed by coral reefs, 2,400km off Africa's south-east coast.

blocks.text: Perfect for Honeymoon Beautiful Beaches Culture
An island known for its rare, varied flora and fauna.
Mauritius is a volcanic island of lagoons and palm-fringed beaches with coral reefs surrounding most of the coastline — 1,865 square kilometers with 330km of coastline.
It was once the only known home of the dodo, which, along with several other avian species, went extinct not long after the island's settlement.
A full-day North tour, a full-day South tour, and an island escape in between.
A privately-owned island in Mauritius' largest lagoon — 87 hectares of preserved white-sand beaches.
Citadelle de Port-Louis, Aapravasi Ghat and Le Caudan — history and heritage in one guided day.
Trou aux Cerfs crater, the Hindu Ganga Talao temple, Chamarel Waterfalls, and the famous 7 Coloured Earths.
Full day-by-day itinerary and hotel options shared on request.
Travellers do not need to register for a visa in advance. Simply provide the necessary documents at the airport and collect your visa on arrival from the relevant authority.
May to December, when the weather is cool, dry and sunny.
Don't trust Google Maps blindly — it isn't well optimized for Mauritius' locations.
Mauritius follows left-hand driving, same as India.

saudi-arabia.name: Saudi Arabia
saudi-arabia.title: Saudi Arabia — the incredible edge of the world.
saudi-arabia.lead: Rich and diverse heritage, striking landscapes, and cities that blend ultramodern skylines with centuries of history.

blocks.text: From gleaming skylines to desert legends.

Ultramodern towers define Riyadh's skyline, hinting at the capital's sophisticated culture, shopping, and dining, while prayer times set the pace for daily life. Gleaming architecture blends with historic landmarks from the kingdom's earliest years.
Beyond the capital, AlUla combines legendary heritage sites — including Hegra, Saudi's first UNESCO World Heritage Site — with outdoor adventure amid dramatic desert landscapes.
Things to do in Saudi Arabia.
Riyadh, Jeddah, and AlUla — three very different sides of the kingdom.
Jebel Fihrayn — a towering plateau two hours from Riyadh, with endless views and awe-inspiring silence.
One of Riyadh's most historically important sites — 'Masmak' means 'strong', and local legend ties its fate to the Kingdom's.
A UNESCO World Heritage Site — once one of the largest cities on the Arabian Peninsula.
One of the newest waterfronts in the world — a Lego-like seaside promenade perfect for a coastal stroll.
A striking geological formation rising three storeys from golden desert sands.
Saudi Arabia's first UNESCO World Heritage Site — carved tombs dating from around the 2nd century BCE.
Full day-by-day itinerary shared on request.
Alcohol and its consumption are strictly prohibited in Saudi Arabia.
Your visa must not be expired, and must have been used for at least one prior trip if applicable.

singapore.name: Singapore
singapore.title: Singapore — passion made possible.
singapore.lead: A country of food, art, culture, diversity, adventure, nature and history, all in one impossibly clean city.

blocks.text: Singapore is much more than a destination. Foodies, explorers, collectors, socialisers, action seekers and cultural shapers can all experience its rich tapestry of art and culture, chase the excitement, and relish the food.
It's a country of food, art, culture, diversity, adventure, nature, and history — what more could anyone ask for?
The highlights our travelers keep coming back for.
Over 1.5 million plants — the Flower Dome, Cloud Forest, and Supertree Grove in one place.
Cable cars, the Merlion Statue, Wings of Time show, S.E.A Aquarium and the Trick Eye Museum.
Meet Minions and Elmo, then ride Battlestar Galactica — the world's tallest duelling roller coasters.
The world's first night zoo — a tram ride through 7 regions, home to 2,500+ animals.
Chinatown, Marina Bay, the Merlion, and Little India — history and mystery in one walk.
Full day-by-day itinerary shared on request.
Original machine-readable passport (2 bio-page copies for West India applicants), valid 6+ months on arrival, with 3 blank pages for stamping.
2 recent photographs (3.5cm x 5cm), a confirmed return air ticket within 30 days, and prior travel history documentation if applicable.
Chewing gum in public — it's banned. Don't bring it.
Don't spit or litter — it's a punishable offence, and the city stays spotless because of it.

sri-lanka.name: Sri Lanka
sri-lanka.title: Sri Lanka — natural, simple, adaptable.
sri-lanka.lead: An ideal winter sun destination — energetic cities, sleepy white-sand beaches, ancient temples, and dramatic scenery.

blocks.text: A tropical alternative to the cold, dark days back home.
Sri Lanka is a wonderful mixture of energetic urban life, long stretches of sleepy white-sanded beaches, ancient temples, dramatic scenery and delicious food.

The island is rich in culture and covered in religious, historically significant sites — for culture lovers, the temples of Anuradhapura, a Buddhist pilgrimage site with wonderful stupas, are an absolute must.
Things to do in Sri Lanka.
From Kandy's sacred temples to Bentota's coastline.
One of Sri Lankan Buddhism's most sacred sites, housing the left canine tooth relic of Lord Buddha.
A window into rural Sri Lanka, and one of the most memorable stops on any itinerary.
Tea estates on misty hillsides, the Ramboda Waterfall, and colonial-era British architecture.
A UNESCO World Heritage Site — Ravana's ancient rock palace, one of Sri Lanka's seven listed sites.
A resort town with pristine, palm-fringed beaches — great for water sports and the Kosgoda turtle hatchery.
Warm hospitality, charming weather, and the lively Pettah Floating Market.
Full day-by-day itinerary shared on request.
Visa on arrival is available for Indians. For short visits, travelers should obtain an ETA (Electronic Travel Authorization) online in advance.
The ETA is initially valid for 30 days from arrival, and can be extended up to 6 months.
A year-round destination — temperatures average between 22°C and 31°C throughout.
Colombo's culture, climbing Adam's Peak, Galle's history, the ruins of Sigiriya, and the tea plantations.

thailand.name: Thailand
thailand.title: Thailand — Bangkok, Pattaya, Phuket, Krabi.
thailand.lead: Beautiful beaches, an international destination that still feels wonderfully inexpensive.

blocks.text: A treasure cache of cultural attractions.

Bangkok will never let you down — a city full of life, offering cultural and spiritual amenities in the same afternoon. Go from spa to resorts, shopping to partying all night, pubs to exotic Buddhist temples.
Further south, Phuket and Krabi bring tropical beaches, hidden temples, local markets and a thumping club scene — mellow in the sun, thrive at night.
Bangkok, Pattaya, Phuket, and Krabi — each with its own personality.
Gleaming temples, a tuk tuk ride, the floating market, and delicious street food.
A luxurious 5-star cruise on the Chao Phraya River, dazzling in the country of smiles.
Parasailing, sea walking, glass-bottom boat snorkelling, jet skiing and banana boat riding.
Phi Phi & James Bond Islands, Phuket
A speedboat trip around the Phi Phi archipelago, plus the island made famous by 007.
Get up close with tigers, then visit the 148ft Big Buddha atop Nakkerad Hills.
Hong Island's coral reefs and sea caves, plus a 40°C hot stream waterfall in Khao Nor Chu Chi National Park.
Every package includes private airport transfers, temple tours, and island/coral excursions with tickets. Full day-by-day itinerary shared on request.
Indians get Visa on Arrival in Thailand — no need to pre-apply. Walk in just like entering any city in India.
Always take your shoes off entering authentic restaurants, temples and local shops — following Thai culture matters.

vietnam.name: Vietnam
vietnam.title: Vietnam — timeless charm.
vietnam.lead: Fascinating history, gorgeous landscapes, incredible food, and an energy that pulls you in from every angle.

blocks.text: A trip you've never quite taken before.
Vietnam is arguably one of the most beautiful countries in south-eastern Asia. Its fascinating history, gorgeous landscapes, tasty food, and vibrant energy awaken all your senses at once.
The best approach: expect nothing, and let the thrill, serenity, and relaxation take over.
Four cities, four completely different moods.
Formerly Saigon — vibrating with energy and traffic, the economic heart of Vietnam.
Broad beaches, fantastic street food, and the fabled Hai Van Pass.
Where the bold march of progress slows to a leisurely amble through the Old Town.
Mouthwatering street food, fascinating history, and a genuinely diverse cultural mix.
Part of Vietnam's extensive underground wartime network — one of Ho Chi Minh City's most iconic sights.
Rice terraces, limestone outcrops and caves — nicknamed 'Ha Long Bay on land'.
Hanoi, Halong Bay & Ho Chi Minh combos.
Full day-by-day itinerary shared on request.
Getting a business or tourist visa is simple — it's a 3-step process, applied for online through Vietnam's official e-visa portal.
It's electronically issued as a Single Entry Visa, and must be requested at least 2 days before your departure date.
Around March-April and October-December, when the weather is comfortable and festivals run across the country.
